description: Canonical, machine-checkable durable negative memory for rejected research fingerprints. Exact rejected fingerprints must not re-enter selection/deep validation without materially new data or a genuinely different frozen scientific/economic hypothesis. Full immutable evidence remains available at the referenced commits/artifacts/evidence files.

entries.hypothesis: Exact-shared-timestamp completed-candle OKX mark/index basis carries incremental after-cost predictive value for 24h/7d direction.
entries.economic_mechanism: Persistent mark-index basis dislocations proxy funding/positioning pressure that mean-reverts or continues predictably enough to survive realistic trading costs.
entries.rejection_reason: The predeclared 8,000-hour chronological evidence window falsified both primary horizons after realistic costs: negative average net expectancy on 24h and 7d.
entries.reconsideration_conditions: A materially different economic mechanism computed from genuinely new timestamp-safe inputs, evaluated on a fresh predeclared window with its own frozen baseline, may be proposed as a new fingerprint. Re-testing this exact fingerprint on the same or overlapping evidence is not legitimate reconsideration.

entries.hypothesis: Funding-rate-derived positioning pressure carries incremental after-cost predictive value for 24h/7d direction beyond the frozen training-only baseline.
entries.economic_mechanism: Extreme or persistent funding rates proxy crowded positioning that mean-reverts or precedes liquidation cascades predictably enough to survive realistic trading costs.
entries.rejection_reason: Zero incremental 24h OOS expectancy versus the frozen training-only baseline despite a positive headline return, unstable across OOS halves; 7d fell below the predeclared independent-sample floor.
entries.reconsideration_conditions: A materially different economic mechanism using funding/positioning data, with its own fresh frozen baseline/window and required independent OOS sample floors, may be proposed under a new fingerprint. Re-testing this exact fingerprint is not legitimate reconsideration.

entries.hypothesis: Predeclared 24h relative-strength variants (4,16,64), (6,24,72), and (8,32,96) produce stable positive after-cost selection evidence across both supported liquidity subsets.
entries.economic_mechanism: Cross-sectional relative strength may persist because information and capital diffuse unevenly across liquid crypto assets, creating continuation that survives realistic costs.
entries.rejection_reason: No predeclared variant passed the required stability rule across both supported liquidity subsets. The superficially positive Top-30 result for (6,24,72) failed Top-15 and is ineligible. Untouched OOS remains unopened.
entries.reconsideration_conditions: Reopen only for materially new data or a genuinely different scientific/economic hypothesis with a new immutable fingerprint, frozen selection contract, defensible provenance and multiple-testing controls. Do not relax the two-subset stability rule or tune this fingerprint using rejected evidence.

entries.hypothesis: A fixed one-hour compression-to-20-bar-breakout rule with volatility-scaled exits has positive incremental after-cost expectancy versus the same breakout rule without compression across a predeclared fixed set of liquid crypto perpetuals.
entries.economic_mechanism: Low realized range can reflect temporary order-flow balance; a subsequent close beyond a recent range can reveal a new directional imbalance that persists as liquidity and leveraged positioning adjust.
horizons_evaluated: 1H bars with maximum 24 full post-entry bars
entries.rejection_reason: Frozen fixed-instrument selection failed pre-OOS: 0/3 instruments passed; pooled train/validation expectancy strongly negative after 3x cost stress; PF below 1; both validation halves negative; challenger worse than losing baseline; BEAR catastrophic-instability guard failed; both predeclared sensitivities failed.
entries.reconsideration_conditions: Do not tune compression quantile, 20-bar breakout, ATR exits, fixed assets, or 1H timeframe using rejected outcomes. Reconsider only a materially different mechanism under a new immutable fingerprint and pre-outcome contract.

entries.hypothesis: A large completed one-hour price shock accompanied by unusually high quote volume and unusually wide intrabar range reflects temporary forced-order-flow/liquidity overshoot and has positive next-six-hour opposite-direction after-cost expectancy versus the same large-return reversal without liquidity filters.
entries.economic_mechanism: Forced liquidations, urgent inventory transfer, and temporary order-book depletion can push price beyond short-run equilibrium; liquidity replenishment may then produce mean reversion.
horizons_evaluated: 1H signals with next-open entry and fixed 6H hold
entries.rejection_reason: The frozen v1 screen failed broadly before OOS: 0/3 fixed instruments passed; all three had negative 3x-cost train and validation expectancy; pooled train and validation expectancy were negative with validation PF 0.456; both validation halves were negative; both sigma falsifier sensitivities were negative. Liquidity filters slightly improved validation versus the baseline but remained strongly unprofitable.
entries.reconsideration_conditions: Do not tune the shock threshold, volume/range filters, hold, fixed assets, or 1H timeframe using these rejected outcomes. Reconsider only with materially new data or a genuinely different frozen economic/scientific hypothesis under a new fingerprint.
